recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core follow-up is needed unless the work group reopens placement or datatype of include-level copyright statements.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocab issue asking R5 to add ValueSet.compose.include.copyright as a 0..1 element for copyright specific to the included code system, or to the code system/version combination when include.version is present.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-28297 commit was found. Git pickaxe history shows 054eabf3116825c0f65107fedff6668447bf43a1 added ValueSet.compose.include.copyright to source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml for R5, and R5 publication exposed it as 0..1 string with the requested definition.
additional_context: FHIR-39595 later changed the element datatype from string to markdown and was applied by 39f96b21ce8d65b5b086b3ee61a455e47a359a98. Vocab minutes record the original 15-0-0 approval, and later CPG/CQI notes questioned placement but moved on because FHIR-28297 had already been voted. Zulip searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source has ValueSet.compose.include.copyright with the requested semantics and cardinality, and current markdown type reflects later WG intent rather than an unapplied part of FHIR-28297.

related_jiras.note: Changed ValueSet.compose.include.copyright from string to markdown after the original R5 addition.
